notes.title: Japanese now available! + Tokyo Indie Game Summit 2025
notes.content:
Japanese Language option now available!
As always, you can choose your language from the title menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889345/d5e3cdadb2f9edc37497df009826f27478d8e2c5.jpg
Thank you very much to everyone who helped make this translation possible! Free Will was inspired by a number of Japanese role-playing games, so this translation means a lot to us.

Future plans for translating into other languages
The only translations we had in mind were Chinese and Japanese due to the team’s connections and capabilities. However, if you are interested in translating Free Will into another language, please reach out to us.

A note about translations for future updates

Update announcements going forward will be released in English only. Translation work takes time, and if there are small bugs or fixes that we can address, we want those fixes to go out as soon as possible. 

This excludes language-specific updates, or announcements where a specific language’s translation makes sense, in which case updates will be made in both English and the language in question.

Unfortunately, our team is quite small, and it's already been difficult to account for translating updates into Chinese. As this issue will only increase if more languages are added to the game, this is the best way we could think of to address this going forward.

We apologize for the inconvenience this may cause.

We’ll be at Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025!
The game’s director, producer/lead artist, and lead audio designer/composer will be traveling to Tokyo, Japan, to table at Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025 in March. If you are attending the event, look out for our table! (More details to come as the event draws closer.)

We plan to sell acrylic keychains of Will, Wendy, and Kipps and a physical CD of the game’s soundtrack at the event. This will be the first time these items have ever been made available. Stop by for some Free Will TIGS 2025 memorabilia, or if you’d like to help us recuperate the cost of our plane tickets and hotel fees!


Once again, on behalf of the team, thank you all for your support!

Patch notes
Version 1.3.0

 Added Japanese as a language option
 Updated credits to reflect the Japanese localization update
 Modified the Medical Report (English)
 Modified credits scroll rate
 Modified the scaling for the language icon on the title screen
 Changed the size of the Options menu and the Controls menu to accommodate all languages


Other updates

 Updated the soundtrack page to accommodate new album art.


Note: Players who update the game may encounter a bug where all text fields will state something like "No translation found for ....". This can be fixed by uninstalling and reinstalling the game.

notes.title: Chinese Localization is HERE!
notes.content:
Traditional and Simplified Chinese now available!
We are very excited to announce that localization for the Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese are now officially available! 

Starting today, you can choose a language via the TITLE SCREEN and experience the unique charm this game offers. 
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44889345/597e00b0918c43de6dcf4bfa070702ab83b8917f.png

Thank you to all players for your patience and support. We hope this update will allow more Chinese-speaking players to enjoy the fun and depth of Free Will. We have put in our utmost effort into the localization, but if there are any mistakes, please let us know in the forums. 

Our next goal is a full Japanese localization, so stay tuned!

Once again, on behalf of our team, thank you all for your support!

Other:

notes.title: Streamer Mode is Live!
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 is now available!
Version 1.1.0 primarily brings Streamer Mode, along with a number of bug fixes. To those who have been excited to stream the game but wanted to wait for this update, thank you for your patience! 


In addition to Streamer Mode, this update will also hide save file information from players. Early on in development, we thought we'd be doing more with the player-editable save files, but this never ended up being the case. Currently, it seems it only causes confusion and has caused some to softlock or screw up the game's sequencing by tampering with it excessively. 
We apologize for the confusing playthroughs some may have experienced as a result of the old system, and hopefully for those that did experience these sequencing bugs, playing through version 1.1.0 will result in the game's narrative making more sense.

[hr][/hr] 
Edit: For those who have old save data from Version 1.0.0: here is how to reimport your save data into Version 1.1.0:

Close the game, if it is open, then navigate to the game's file directory (same place where you solve most puzzles, accessible by right-clicking the game in your Steam Library and selecting "Manage > Browse local files")
Copy the old save file, which should still be in the game's local files as save.txt
Navigate to C:\Users\(Your PC's username)\AppData\LocalLow\Kipps in a Box\Free Will (this is a hidden directory: you can find it by pasting %appdata% into your Windows search bar)
Paste save.txt into the Free Will folder
Launch the game, and your old save data should be read.

Thank you Fury72888hshu for the comment--we'd forgotten to include this in the announcement prior.
[hr][/hr] 


Bug Fixes

Fixed a major bug for European and Canadian players related to the [spoiler]date and time[/spoiler] puzzle's backend formatting. It should now work for players in these regions.
Replaying the maze with a completed map from a previous playthrough now respawns the player to the correct position
Fixed issues related to Will's player character getting stuck on certain objects and walls
Door.png is no longer recreated upon reentering Will's room after completing the door puzzle
Added a backup for the [spoiler]second Free Will window executable in Dad's Study [/spoiler]
Corrected an animation error in [spoiler]Wendy's[/spoiler] fight
Fixed dialogue advancing if the inventory was open
Fixed a visual bug that could occur by spamming the Interact button on the first-floor closet door
Fixed an issue where the inventory would not open in [spoiler]Wendy's room[/spoiler]
Fixed inventory not opening in the [spoiler]Free Wendy[/spoiler] ending
Fixed colliders for the [spoiler]mountains of bodies[/spoiler] in the basement
Fixed various minor typos and formatting issues in dialogue
Fixed dialogue that displayed when interacting with the kitchen fridge
Corrected the font and font color of some menus

More bug fixes will be pushed in future updates--our team is small, so we ask for your understanding as these things take time. 
With that said, thank you for reporting bugs through the bug form and in the discussion forum! And additional thanks for those who joined the Discord server to talk through the bugs they were having--we apologize for the inconvenience, especially for our EU/CAN players…!


New Feature: Streamer Mode
Streamer Mode can be enabled to ensure potentially sensitive player information, namely the player's PC name or Steam username, are not shown on screen while playing the game.
An unskippable window will appear at the start of a new game asking if you would like to enable the mode or not. You can also toggle the setting on and off in the settings, though it largely does nothing once you've completed the first fight of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889345/ca85b871a60afac8568b9da1957f8519f3aff135.png


Let us know if you stream the game! You can send us an email or @ us on Twitter/X. We've been checking out various streams ourselves, but as our team is small, we generally only get around to seeing your VODs… :)


Other Changes:

Updated the controls guide
Removed full-screen mode
Save files are now hidden to ensure players do not softlock themselves or trigger events out of order
Added a game factory reset button to the options menu
Added a button to the title screen that allows players to return to [spoiler]the basement, before the point where the game branches[/spoiler] after completing an ending
Special Thanks are now listed properly
NPC names are now disallowed from being the player name
Added a message to confirm your game has been saved
Corrected the Game System’s dialogue boxes during [spoiler]Wendy's[/spoiler] fight to show “SYSTEM MESSAGE” headers
Clickable UI buttons now respond to mouse hover



Future Plans:
More bug fixes will be pushed in smaller updates (1.1.1, 1.1.2, etc.), and we'll update you on when those drop.
Our next big goal is Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese language support, with Traditional Chinese coming first (as the game director is fluent in it). These updates are targeting a summer release: as the release date becomes more certain, we will let you all know.


On behalf of the Kipps in a Box Team, thank you all for supporting Free Will! Our team is grateful for your support.

notes.title: Free Will Release Announcement!
notes.content:
FREE WILL: Available soon!
Hello players, this is the Director of Free Will. Thank you for your interest in our game. We are a group of student developers from the University of Southern California, and this game is my thesis project! I hope you like it, and have a lot of fun (or sufferings).

Read on for more information regarding the release and upcoming plans:


Releasing on May 7th, 2024!
Free Will is being released on May 7th, 2024 at midnight! You can currently obtain two endings, and one of two achievements.


Streaming Disclaimer
Spoiler ahead! 
While we welcome content creation in regards to sharing your playthroughs of Free Will, please be aware that livestreaming certain moments of the game may put your personal information at risk. After the first battle is resolved, personal information will not be shown in game. We plan on adding a streamer mode in a future update to make the game more friendly to stream.

[spoiler]Certain in-game puzzles can only be solved by tweaking system files via your computer’s file explorer.[/spoiler] 
[spoiler]Your local file path and Steam name will be displayed at three points early on. Specifically:[/spoiler]
[olist]
[spoiler]Your steam name will be shown when first starting the game from the title screen.[/spoiler] 
[spoiler]Your computer’s name and a file path to the game executable will be shown when trying to exit the first room at the start of the game and during the first battle.[/spoiler] 
[/olist]

Updates to Come
We’re pleased to announce that we’ve started working on updates to address polish and quality of life. These include:

 Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese localization.
 Implementation of a streamer mode to address privacy concerns.
 Paid DLC that expands on the game through additional endings and content.

We welcome you to try the game and share your thoughts. To report any bugs, please use our  report form .
